meta.title: Saffron & Steam: breakfast, lunch, dinner and chai
meta.description: A neighbourhood café serving South Indian breakfasts, Bengali and North Indian lunches, tandoor dinners and chai all day. Order for pickup, dine-in or delivery, or book a table.

story.title: About the café
story.p1: Saffron & Steam opens at seven with filter coffee and dosa, and closes at eleven after the last butter chicken leaves the tandoor.
story.p2: Vegetables are bought the same morning they're cooked, and the coffee comes from beans roasted in small batches nearby.

about.title: Our story
about.p3: The menu travels: dosa and poha in the morning, Japanese curry and Italian pasta at lunch, the tandoor and French bistro dishes at dinner. What ties it together is cooking everything to order.
about.freshBody: Vegetables, herbs and paneer arrive before breakfast and are used that day.
about.coffeeBody: Our beans come from a small roaster a few streets away, in batches small enough to stay fresh.
about.kitchensBody: Indian, Italian, American, Japanese and French dishes come out of one kitchen, each cooked the way it's cooked at home.
